data.content_ref: inline:The target claims SRC_003 abstracts SRC_005's CRT solution by identifying that 4≡-3 mod 7 and 3≡-2 mod 5 share the structural form of residues expressible as (divisor - offset), and that the 'unified constant-difference identity fails while the general CRT parametric solution succeeds.' This framing is self-defeating as an abstraction relation: if the offsets genuinely differ (-2 vs -3), there is no shared constant-difference identity to abstract in the first place — only a superficial pattern of negative-residue rewriting that diverges on the very parameter the 'abstraction' centers on. The target concedes the abstraction fails at its defining property, leaving the relation as a summary of both artifacts using negative-residue notation rather than a genuine abstraction.
